item.title: Rohit Sharma is no.1 and Virat Kohli is now no.2 in latest update of ICC ODI batting rankings
item.description: Two legendary white-ball batters of the Indian team, Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli, are now the top two-ranked batters in the latest update of the ICC ODI batting rankings, released on December 10, 2025. Rohit Sharma was already the no. 1-ranked ODI batter, and Virat Kohli has joined him at no. 2, thanks to the recent India v. South Africa ODI series. item.title: “We had considered him for the role as early as 2023”: Ex-BCCI selector on Shubman Gill’s promotion as leader
item.description: The year 2025 has been a memorable one for Shubman Gill, who was handed India’s Test captaincy after Rohit Sharma’s retirement from the longest format in May. In his maiden assignment as Test skipper, Gill led the team from the front in England, amassing 754 runs with the help of four centuries to help India pull off a 2-2 draw in the five-match series. item.title: IND v SA 2025: “Jassi bhai still needs to take some more wickets”- Arshdeep Singh jokes how pacer can come on his Instagram
item.description: Arshdeep Singh had a great take on how Jasprit Bumrah may appear on his Instagram clips, similar to how Virat Kohli did recently. Arshdeep's social media game has been on point in recent months, with Indian players regularly appearing in his humorous post-match films. Kohli recently appeared in a viral video following the third ODI against South Africa, in which the star batsman made a hilarious jibe at the pacer. item.title: IND v SA 2025: WATCH- “Jasprit Bumrah ko chakka maarna..”- Aakash Chopra takes dig at Sahibzada Farhan’s documentary for hitting six off pacer
item.description: Former India cricketer Aakash Chopra took a subtle dig at Pakistan’s Sahibzada Farhan and him making a documentary after hitting an Indian pacer for three sixes in the recent Asia Cup T20 2025 tournament. The dig came as India dominated South Africa in the first T20I of the five-match series that was played in Cuttack on December 9. item.title: IND v SA 2025: "Fair call"- Irfan Pathan on India moving forward with Jitesh Sharma over Sanju Samson in middle order role
item.description: Irfan Pathan, ex-India pacer, has backed the inclusion of Jitesh Sharma as the keeper-batter in India’s T20I XI in place of Sanju Samson. He cited Jitesh’s experience in the middle order and as a finisher, compared to Sanju’s success at the top of the batting order. Samson was moved down the batting order following Shubman Gill's return to the top order. item.title: IND v SA 2025: “It was always going to be difficult,” R Ashwin’s blunt analysis of Sanju Samson’s snub from India’s T20I XI
item.description: Sanju Samson failed to make the cut in India’s playing XI for the first T20I against South Africa at Cuttack on Tuesday (December 9). For the talented wicketkeeper-batter, it was probably a signal that he has fallen behind in the team management’s evolving pecking order. During the Asia Cup 2025 in UAE, Shubman Gill’s return to the T20I fold as vice-captain saw Samson losing his spot at the top of the order despite hitting three hundreds last year. item.title: “Gursharan wasn’t supposed to bat,” Sachin Tendulkar reveals how former teammate’s selfless act paved his way into Indian team
item.description: Sachin Tendulkar is widely regarded as one of the greatest batters of all time. Fondly known as the Master Blaster, Tendulkar represented India in 200 Tests, scoring the world record number of runs (15921) and centuries (51). While Tendulkar continues to hold the record for most ODI runs (18426 in 463 matches), his tally of hundreds (49) in the 50-over format has been bettered by compatriot Virat Kohli (53). item.title: WATCH- “Don’t love anything in life more than cricket”- Smriti Mandhana in first public appearance post canceled wedding
item.description: Smriti Mandhana made her first public appearance since the cancellation of her wedding with music composer Palash Muchhal. The couple was supposed to get married on November 23, but Mandhana’s father had to be hospitalized due to health issues. Then Palash was hospitalized in Mumbai, and as a result, on Sunday (December 7), Mandhana and Muchhal posted on social media that they are calling off the wedding. item.title: WATCH- Yashasvi Jaiswal terms Rohit Sharma ‘Dhurandhar’ of Indian team; equates Yuzvendra Chahal with ‘Bahubali’
item.description: Yashasvi Jaiswal, the Indian opener, likened former captain Rohit Sharma to Ranveer Singh's film Dhurandhar.
